BiblicalUsage: Mulah is circumcision — then Zipporah takes a sharp stone and cuts off the foreskin of her son, and casts it at Moses' feet, and says, a bloody husband art thou to me, because of the circumcision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is one of the strangest in the Bible, and the point is plain: the covenant sign cannot be neglected, even on the road to deliver the people.
